text: No, the sources do not agree on whether tree-cover loss occurred on this property in 2012. Hansen GFC detected 1.4 ha of loss, but the JRC 2020 reference map only confirms 49% of that area as non-forest in 2020—falling short of the 50% threshold required for corroboration. MGAP’s 2021 data shows the event area was outside native forest and included 0.4 ha of planted forest, but this doesn’t confirm loss or its cause. The evidence is contradicted, meaning the claim lacks sufficient support.
